mating-face.src: 3-pin XLR socket mating face (IEC 61076-2-103 interface), latch at the top: contact 2 left, 1 right, 3 below, as in the Neutrik NC3FXX front view (drawing ST-NC3FXX); contact spacing (about 8 mm across, 3.9 mm down) taken from the plug drawing NC3MDL-1 (drawing 3102 St 10 16) and mirrored, approximate outline. Drawn for WireHub from public dimensions; CC0-1.0, not traced from any vendor drawing.
